objective: Independently test that all remaining G2 live matrices use the same canonical split-PG RUN boundary without weakening their matrix-specific negative controls.
derive_from_requirements: An accepted input/jobs, hook/env, or takeover run must exhibit ACCEPT, SUPERVISOR, CHILD_PREPARED, EXEC_READY, CHILD, and EXPERIMENT_START in causal order with distinct supervisor/experiment process groups in one session.

A second automatic run is allowed only after verified prior completion, manual ACK/prompt return, fresh same-parent handoff, and a new WAIT observation; prior unknown or missing boundary cannot replay/rearm.
Takeover blocks new automatic requests immediately, preserves already-started work, distinguishes request from ACK (including lost/delayed ACK), and only permits confirmed foreground manual input.
Input/jobs and hook/env retain always-deny/always-allow and marker/state leakage discrimination; tests must fail if a probe silently returns to raw legacy base64/direct eval.
constraints: Do not modify production code or existing tests/probes.
Use bounded runtime, cleanup, and residue assertions; do not rely only on source-string assertions.
Include at least one discriminating negative mutation/control showing legacy transport or missing boundary would be detected.
Do not modify workflow, docs, graphify, or commit/reset/clean/stash.
